correlation-network.interpretation: Correlation describes co-movement in the sample; it does not imply causation.
correlation-network.method: Pearson correlation of daily log returns; classical MDS on sqrt(2(1-rho)); average-linkage clusters.
correlation-network.title: Asset correlation network

model-evaluation.interpretation: Forecast, ranking and regime metrics are not trading profitability or economic validation.
model-evaluation.method: Expanding-window folds on authored synthetic returns; every family is scored separately.

not_computed.BiLSTM: Training is run explicitly in the CPU sequence research workflow, not in this view.

model-evaluation.title: Model evaluation landscape

order-book.method: Authored deterministic depth snapshots; displayed quantity is not executable liquidity.
order-book.title: Displayed depth landscape

risk-terrain.method: Full BSM repricing of long, fully paid European options; scenario P&L is a model difference.
risk-terrain.title: Portfolio stress terrain

stat-arb.method: Causal Kalman [alpha, beta] filter; pre-observation innovations; no smoothing.
stat-arb.regime_model: 2-state Gaussian HMM on z-score changes (filtered, causal)
stat-arb.title: Statistical arbitrage landscape

vol-surface.method: Authored BSM prices inverted numerically to IV (European, r=3%, no dividends).
vol-surface.title: Implied volatility surface
